'''Argente Tower''' was the largest building in [[Murkhana City/Legends|Murkhana City]]. It shared its name with [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]] and served as the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]] headquarters.
